cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said the audition was interesting. What followed that in your head?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. Interesting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say it without looking at the floor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It wasn't what I expected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We're finally approaching the unsent sentence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called my audition interesting. What came after that in your head?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're my sister. I'm trying to be encouraging.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the encouraging half and the half you swallowed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your singing was better than your dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better by how much? Are we buying dance lessons or shoes that don't move?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats 'interesting' as unfinished; A5 treats B4's unexpectedness as another withheld sentence.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 challenges B2's repeated 'interesting'; A5 responds to B4 but gives no specific next demand.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 protect an opinion, but the reason B wants to protect A is unspecified.

heightening.evidence: A5 announces progress toward an 'unsent sentence' without pursuing the new clue in B4.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes an audition; A3 gives an actor a playable eye-contact challenge.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'unsent sentence' is polished commentary on the exchange rather than a sharp new interrogation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 interrogates 'interesting'; A3 and A5 keep treating protective encouragement and comparison as incomplete.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's wish to encourage; A5 asks how much worse the dancing is after B4's comparison.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies sibling loyalty as the reason for caution, and B4 risks a more revealing assessment.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from detecting withheld criticism to demanding the practical severity of the dancing problem.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes an audition, B2 a sibling relationship, and B4 the singing-versus-dancing distinction.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's swallowed half is concise; A5's motionless shoes extend the dancing assessment with some comic exaggeration.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 admits protective encouragement; A3 asks for both that encouragement and the suppressed assessment.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 ranks singing above dancing; A5 presses for the size and implications of that gap.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Each A turn treats B's careful wording as evidence of something still withheld.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 asks whether the hidden criticism calls for improvement or effectively avoiding movement.

beats.text: I'm already assuming it silently. Give it a name.
